main_text.l: mæ filiæ. Quadragesimale seruitium disposuit: & ante horam sextam officia celebrari constituit. Ecclesias quasdam in urbe ædificijs ampliauit, ac earum dedicationibus nouas cæremonias addidit. Ex æstiuo calore tandem, anno Domini 767. pinguis hic porcus obiit, restitutis quibusdam sanis[?], ruina collabentibus. Vt Petrus Præmonstratensis refert, huius Pauli tempore, stellæ de cœlo in terram cadebant, iuxta id quod scribitur, Apoc.6. & Carolus Magnus statim incepit regnare, qui ædificauit 24. monasteria.

Constantinus fecundus, natione Romanus, Desiderij Longobardorum regis frater, impulsu dicti Desiderij, per Tothonem, Nepesinum ducem, cum plures eandem ambirent sedem, ex laico Papa consecrabatur. Sed temeritas (ut Crantzius scribit) consecrantis Sergii Hostiensis vel Gergii Præneftini, mox paralysi cæditur, quod non effet Constantinus sacris initiatus, tam periculosa res esset, primo Bestiæ characterc non insigniri. Hinc multæ sunt in clero excitatæ discordiæ, inter quas Philippus quidam ab aliis eligebatur, sed statim eo ab officio, armis inferior, se iterum abdicare coactus fuit. Impleuit Constantinus pontificium munus per annum unum: ac pontificalia valde pont

page.notes: Printed page number reads "9o" with the o as a superscript-style figure; transcribed as 90. Several words are damaged or faint: "sanis" (letter shape uncertain, could be "fanis"), "Gergii" (possibly "Gregorii"), "characterc" (printed as written, possibly "charactere" with a worn final letter), "Sergii" and "Gergii" as printed. The Greek-free text has no notes, footnotes or margin text. Ink smudges at the bottom are not printed text and were omitted. Printed spellings "obijt", "Hoftienfis", "Nepefinum", "confecrabatur" and "quòd" were corrected to standard i/j, u/v and s forms per the transcription rules only where the rules apply; the rest are as printed.
